newsitem.title: FRANCE: France says Sierra Leone evacuation over.
newsitem.headline: France says Sierra Leone evacuation over.

text.p: The French navy has successfully completed the evacuation of foreigners from the strife-torn Sierra Leone capital of Freetown, the French Foreign Ministry said on Friday.

Spokesman Jacques Rummelhardt said two French vessels took the foreigners to Conakry, the capital of neigbouring Guinea, on Thursday in the second such operation since a military coup on May 25 and subsequent clashes between the rebels and Nigerian troops.
It said earlier 734 foreign nationals, including three French people, were on board.
The United States has also carried out two similar operations, ferrying foreigners to a helicopter carrier at sea.

Sierra Leone's coupmakers and their rebel allies say they want a negotiated settlement to their standoff with regional giant Nigeria but will not reinstate toppled civilian president Ahmad Tejan Kabbah.
